annotations.title: Rename a Meta audience or remove people from it

description: Change an existing Meta custom audience: action rename (name and/or description; read back) | remove_users (take people OUT of a customer list: schema + rows in the same shape create_meta_audience uploads, e.g. schema ["EMAIL"] and rows [["a@b.com"]]; Hermoso normalises and SHA-256-hashes every value exactly as an upload does, so a row removes the person it added; up to 10,000 rows; customer lists only). Removing people narrows who ads reach, so it needs confirm:true after the user agrees; Meta applies it in the background and reports how many rows it received. Add people with create_meta_audience (audienceId + rows); delete a whole audience with delete_meta_audience. Free.

adAccountId.description: Meta ad account id (act_123 or digits); one this brand has shared

confirm.description: remove_users: true after the user agreed

rows.description: remove_users: the people, each row in schema order (plain text or SHA-256 already)

schema.description: remove_users: column names in order, from EMAIL, PHONE, FN, LN, FI, CT, ST, ZIP, COUNTRY, DOB, DOBY, GEN, MADID, EXTERN_ID

name: manage_meta_audience
